title: Numbers from another location or not allowed to open are plain text
refs: SV-11718 (Reports Story 2 S2-N1 Reports Story 3 S3-R2)
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Use a staging client with two locations, location 1 and location 2.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with a part in category A, cost $100.00, priced $121.50 by tier A, invoiced today.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, at location 2, for customer A, with a part in category A, invoiced today.
  • Have a second user for this test with 'Reports — Page Access' at location 1 but not 'See Financial Data', signed in in a second browser window.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Pick location 1 and location 2 in the Location filter.
  3. Pick customer A in the Customer filter.
  4. Open tier A's row.
  5. Open customer A's row.
  6. Open the same rows as the second user.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier opens at location 1.

Step 2:

  • Both locations are picked.

Step 3:

  • The Customer chip shows customer A.

Step 4:

  • Customer A is listed.

Step 5:

  • Work order 1's invoice number is a blue link.
  • Work order 2's invoice number (location 2) is plain text.

Step 6:

  • For the second user, work order 1's invoice number is plain text.
  • Its figures still show.
